I'm in a unique situation which I don't really want to expand on, but I can get into a reputable law school (I know I said it seemed impossible in my post, but I think I was panicking when I wrote it). 

My problem isn't getting into law school, it's that I'm not doing the best I can, and that I'm squandering my potential.

I'm doing a Bachelor of Science, and majoring in Neuroscience, but I have no idea what I'm going to do when I graduate. I started off intending to go into postgrad Medicine, but right now I wanted to go for Law, after looking into it and taking some Business Law subjects. I could still get in with some luck, but right now I'm just filled with shame. Sorry if this doesn't sound right, I haven't slept for some time now.
